programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Casa Paradiso/Gerald''s Tonsils: Grandpa becomes tired of dealing with the boarding house and decides to sell./Gerald has his tonsils removed before a big concert and must come to grips with the fact that his voice has changed.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.sub-title: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War
programme.desc: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War: Phoebe agrees to take a dive so that Helga can win a competition./The boys engage in a recreation of a historical battle, only this time their prized pig is in danger of losing his life.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Best Man/Cool Party: The Coach wants to remarry Tish and asks Arnold to be his best man./ Rhonda has a party and only invites the cool kids.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Sid''s Revenge/Roller Coaster: After Arnold accidentally embarrasses Sid, Sid seeks revenge./ Eugene wants to ride with the gang, but they all think he''s a jinx and won''t go with him.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Grandpa's Birthday/Road Trip: Grandpa thinks he's going to die soon because no one in his family ever made it past his age. He prepares to die, and Arnold tries to convince him that life is still worth living.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold and Lila/Grand Prix: Helga, lost in a love reverie, writes "Arnold loves Helga" on a wall, but changes the name to "Lila" when the kids approach. Lila thinks that Arnold loves her until he explains the mistake.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Girl Trouble/School Dance: Arnold tells Grandpa he''s tired of dealing with Helga''s nonsense. Grandpa tells Arnold a story about a girl he had to deal with when he was a kid who treated him the same way. She turns out to be Grandma.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Helga's Show/Flood: Helga does a standup routine at a school function and proceeds to insult all of her friends. They are offended, prompting her to change her act to a more friendly and gentle routine. She performs the new act, but it's boring.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold and Helga perform a \"Romeo and Juliet\"- type play for a school production

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: At the Parent's Day competition, Arnold learns that even though he doesn't have \"real\" parents, his grandparents are just as good as everyone else's parents.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Eugene's Birthday/Stinky's Pumpkin
programme.desc: Eugene's Birthday: Arnold is the cause of two birthday party's for Eugene being a big flop. Stinky's Pumpkin: Stinky feels that he is a failure at everything he does until Arnold helps him discover that he is the best pumpkin grower in town.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Dinner for Four/Phoebe Skips
programme.desc: Dinner for Four: After winning coupons to a fancy French restaurant, Helga attempts to prove to Arnold that she is more sophisticated than Lila. Phoebe Skips: Helga is devastated when her patsy, Phoebe, is skipped to the 6th grade.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Full Moon/Student Teacher
programme.desc: Full moon: When the gang all decide that they are going to "moon" Principal Wartz, Arnold thinks that it's a bad idea, but ends up inadvertently getting caught and taking the blame. Student Teacher: Olga comes to PS 118 to be a student teacher.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Big Gino/Jamie O in Luv
programme.desc: Big Gino: Sid gets in over his head when doing business with the local kid loan shark, Big Gino. Jamie O in Luv: Gerald's big brother, Jamie O, falls for a girl and suddenly turns nice to his kid brother.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Beeper Queen/Oscar Can't Read?
programme.desc: Beeper Queen: Big Bob pulls his back and cannot go to a very important meeting. Not knowing who else to send in his place, he asks Helga. Oscar Can't Read?: When Arnold discovers that Oskar has been pretending to know how to read, Arnold confronts him.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: The Headless Cabbie/Friday the 13th
programme.desc: The Headless Cabbie: Wolfgang dares Arnold and the gang to break superstitions, which causes a spate of bad luck to erupt. Friday the 13th: At a sleepover, Arnold and the boys sit around and tell scary stories.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Helga's Parrot/Chocolate Turtles
programme.desc: Helga's Parrot: Big Bob gets a pesky parrot he passes to Helga, who confides in it about Arnold. Chocolate Turtles: Arnold and Gerald sell chocolate turtles to fund their go-cart project.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Love and Cheese/Weighing Harold
programme.desc: Love and Cheese: Arnold goes all out to win Lila's affection by taking her to the Annual Cheese Festival. Weighing Harold: Harold feels that he has gotten too fat, so he gets his parents to send him on a weight-off cruise.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: It Girl/Deconstructing Arnold
programme.desc: It Girl: Helga becomes the latest child fashion star and everyone loves her for her scowl and bad attitude. Deconstructing Arnold: The gang finally gets sick of Arnold's never-ending good advice, so they all decide to stop listening to him all together.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Grudge Match/Polishing Rhonda
programme.desc: Grudge Match: Arnold and Grandpa vs Helga and Big Bob in a fender bender blame game. Polishing Rhonda: Rhonda and Patty's rivalry heats up at finishing school.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Back to School/Egg Story

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Weird Cousin/Baby Oskar
programme.desc: Weird Cousin: Arnold's weird cousin, Arnie, arrives for a visit and appears to be the biggest loser to everyone except Lila, the love of Arnold's life. Baby Oskar: Oskar's wife Susie agrees to watch her cousin's baby, also named Oskar.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Helga Sleepwalks/Fighting Families
programme.desc: Helga Sleepwalks: Helga begins to sleepwalk and ends up walking to Arnold's house. Fighting Families: The Fighting Families Contest has come to town and have selected two families: one from PS 118 and PS 119.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Monkeyman!/Buses, Bikes, Subways
programme.desc: Monkeyman!: Arnold is saved from thugs by a mysterious, caped character named Monkeyman. Buses, Bikes, Subways: Out on a field trip, Harold and Helga miss the bus and get separated from the rest of the class.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!: Grandpa's Sister/Synchronized Swimming

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.1
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China’s most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch âThe Splitterâ to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of âverticalâ monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealandâs nine Great Walks faster than theyâve ever been done before, using human power alone. Itâs the ultimate adventure race. Theyâll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europeâs most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca CamÃ­ de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race â itâs a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling â every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection â with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Ultra Vegans
programme.desc: For endurance athletes, getting the right diet can make the difference between success and failure. Many are now choosing to adopt a plant based regime and they are witnessing some remarkable results in terms of performance and recovery. Athletes, fitness coaches, sports nutritionists, ultra runners are sharing with us their experience and conviction wether they are motivated by self performance or animal wellfare.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Spartan Beast World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Spartan is back again to the culturally rich and visually intoxicating dunes of Abu Dhabi, UAE for the 2025 Spartan World Championship hosted by Abu Dhabi Sports Council. The Spartan World Championship weekend will include a variety of different World Championship races. A select group of top elites will battle for the 3K Elite World Championship title, while Elite and Age Group racers looking for a more grueling challenge will take on the qualification-based 21K Beast Championships.

programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 2.

programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid TÃ©miscamingue.

programme.title: Spartan Super World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: High in Californias Sierra Nevada, the world gathers for a new test of endurance. This is the Spartan Super World Championship 2025, hosted by Mammoth Lakes, California. A race that starts at 2,400 metres above sea level and climbs higher still. Every athlete knows what waits ahead. 11 kilometres, 26 obstacles and the full force of the mountain.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2025 - Christmas Special Edition
programme.desc: We start this episode from Romania. In our previous episodes, we covered the exciting 2025 edition of Brasov Running Festival, highlighting the effort of the Elite 10k athletes. However, the Brasov Running Festival is much more than just the elite competitors. We then shift our focus to cycling, moving on to Turkey for another edition of LÃtape TÃ¼rkiye by Tour de France. Moving from Turkey, we catch a flight to Croatia for Spartan Trail Dubrovnik. Since this is the last episode of the TV Show for 2025, we also got a glimpse of some of the most notable moments we enjoyed over the previous months.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: Â«The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!â. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichÃ©sâ¦ but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Birdâs Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters â the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the worldâs finest.

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 1.

programme.title: The Road Ahead
programme.desc: Fredrik Erixon, a passionate adventurer crosses Sweden on roller skis from the north in Karesuando in Lappland, to Smygehuk in Skane in the south â a solo journey of about 2000 km over thirty days - representing one Vasaloppet a day (most famous cross country ski race). He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.title: Skoda Titan Desert Almeria 2025
programme.desc: Four intense days of mountain biking through AlmerÃ­aâs stunning landscapes â from coast to desert, across sand, hills, and rugged trails. Amateurs and pros alike face the heat, the wind, and their own limits. More than a race, itâs an adventure of endurance, camaraderie, and pure adrenaline beyond the stopwatch.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each dayâs riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Cro Race 2025
programme.desc: The 2025 CRO Race is a road cycling stage race (6 stages - 900 km) in Croatia held between 30 September and 5 October 2025. It is the tenth edition of the Tour of Croatia since its revival in 2015 and the sixth under the CRO Race name. The race is rated as a category 2.1 event on the 2025 UCI Europe Tour calendar

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australiaâs greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: 2025 Aus Cycling MTB Enduro National Championships
programme.desc: A rain-soaked Collie, Western Australia, becomes the stage for Australiaâs premier Enduro showdown, where world-class Wambenger Trails and the iconic Wellington Dam mural frame a weekend of grit, flow and community. Across Juniors, Masters, Adaptive and E-bike fields, riders wrestle slick rock, pea gravel and long liaison climbs as stories of resilience emerge. The result is a kinetic, human-centred portrait of Australian MTB: fast, muddy, inclusive, and unforgettable.

programme.title: Blind Ambition
programme.desc: In a world where limits are defined by sight, one man dares to see beyond. Gerrard Gosens â totally blind adventurer, Paralympian, Everest summiteer, and recipient of the Order of Australia Medal â sets his sights on a challenge no (totally Blind from Birth) human has ever completed: conquering the 20 Bridges circumnavigation of Manhattan Island. Battling currents, cold, and crushing fatigue, Gerrard and his team must navigate one of the most iconic open water swims on the planet, at night. This is a story of courage without boundaries, of finding light in total darkness, and of one man and his teams fight to etch his name into historyâs Ides.A film by Anthony Gordon

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italyâs maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing eventâit has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George BjÃ¤lkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challengeâ¦ winning the 75 km ÃtillÃ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelagoâ¦ in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the seasonâs final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: TaÃ­ba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The worldâs top riders will take to TaÃ­baâs powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the menâs and womenâs world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Dakhla - Morocco 2025
programme.desc: A full roster of 28 men and 16 women, from a total of 16 countries around the world, are set to join the line-up in Dakhla for five days of intense action that could have a key bearing on who takes the titles. Reigning world champions, Franceâs Capucine Delannoy and Brazilâs Gabriel Benetton, top the Kite-Surf rankings as they head to the seasonâs penultimate stop in Dakhla, Morocco, on the Sahara desertâs coastline.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabiâs newest coastal wellness destination and the worldâs first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

In Palestina staan 8,500 politieagenten voor een nog grotere uitdaging: werken in een gefragmenteerd, politiek gespannen landschap waar elke patrouille risico's met zich meebrengt.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1
programme.desc: In Catalonië heeft de regionale politie het overgenomen van de Spaanse nationale politie en een snelle-reactie-eenheid op motoren ingezet om de stedelijke criminaliteit aan te pakken. Ondertussen werkt de politie in Haifa, de belangrijkste havenstad van Israël, volgens strenge wetten in een gespannen omgeving die wordt gevormd door terrorismedreigingen en het voortdurende regionale conflicten.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1
programme.desc: In Brazilië is de rivier de Paraná een belangrijke smokkelroute, die wordt bewaakt door NEPOM, een gespecialiseerde eenheid van de rivierpolitie. In Guayaquil, Ecuador, werkt de politie samen met lokale gemeenschappen om alle vormen van mensenhandel ter plaatse te bestrijden.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S2

programme.desc: Holy Hollywood Weapons! Terry and Larry put some of your favorite Superhero's to the test. Tune in to the same Bat Outdoor Channel for the results.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "Terry Reacher"
programme.desc: We're putting Jack Reacher to the test! The movie, the series, and the pie!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "The Harder Terry Falls"
programme.desc: Dust off your chaps as Terry tests several things from the epic western The Harder They Fall, and a canteen buster test from Gunsmoke!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "The Schappert Identity"
programme.desc: Terry channels his inner Jason Bourne to test some of the best moments from the series of films.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "We Do It For You"
programme.desc: We go to the mail room for viewer requests as Terry and Larry take a look into famous scenes from Yellowstone, SWAT, Fast and Furious.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "Leftovers Again?"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test things they never got to from other episodes. Pull up a chair and get ready for leftovers, and a surprise guest!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "Punishing Larry"
programme.desc: Grenades, propane tanks, and a bathtub, all adds up to some big tests of the popular comic book character.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "Terry Loves Action Movies"
programme.desc: From Polar, to James Bond, the Lethal Weapon, Terry loves action movies and is putting some of the best ones to the test!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S6 - "Terry Nobody"
programme.desc: We're putting the action-packed film Nobody to the test. Booby Traps, Claymores and Riot shields make for an interesting day at the range.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Impossible Ice"
programme.desc: A family in Saskatchewan call in a team of ice road truckers to haul their 3-storey wooden home across a frozen lake.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Supersize Station"
programme.desc: A family in Saskatchewan calls in a crew of house haulers to move an ornate railway station across the state so they can transform it into a dream home.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Pacific Palace"
programme.desc: A family in Vancouver calls in a crew of house truckers to haul a beautiful two-storey house across land and water so they can have a bigger home.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Harbour House"
programme.desc: A couple in Vancouver call in a crew of marine engineers to build and sail a beautiful floating house down the Fraser River and out to sea, to get to their moorings.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Floating Fortress"
programme.desc: A family hires a team of marine engineers in Vancouver to build and sail an enormous floating home down a busy river to reach their moorings.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "River Rescue"
programme.desc: A family in Washington state hires a crew of house truckers to rescue their beloved home that is about to fall off the edge of a crumbling cliff into a raging river.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Minnesota Family Farmhouse"
programme.desc: A family in Minnesota hire a team of house truckers to move their historic farmstead closer to work to eliminate their daily commutes.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Million Dollar Mansion"
programme.desc: The Pilcher family in Saskatchewan call in a team of house truckers to haul their stunning mansion across rough fields and down narrow lanes to save it from being demolished.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Hawaii House Chop"
programme.desc: A team of house truckers in Hawaii move a stunning house to a new plot of land for an entrepreneur in Honolulu.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Runway Race"
programme.desc: A family in St Cloud, Minnesota call in a team of house movers to move a beautiful two-storey home, destined to be their son’s first home, to rescue it from the wrecking ball.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Colossal Cabin"
programme.desc: A family in Greenville, Florida calls in a team of house haulers to move their much-loved holiday log cabin along a treacherous route to a new site.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Spring"
programme.desc: The sun heats the earth and life begins again. The animals wake from hibernation and busy themselves, building their nests in treetops and caves as they prepare to breed. All the spring babies are fighting for survival though their first days.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Summer"
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Autumn"
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep, and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Winter"
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: A rhino ear notching goes terribly wrong when a large bull starts attacking the drugged female. Up at the Animal Hospital the world’s tallest patient checks in and the struggle begins to get the baby giraffe to drink.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: Our vet Johan ends up with a buffalo up his backside when one of the animals they are testing for tuberculosis wakes up. We have a difficult decision to make, rescue an orphaned baby elephant or leave it to die a slow, cruel death in the bush.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: The wildlife team comes under attack from an angry rhino after releasing it from its holding crate. Our orphaned baby elephant is settling nicely into his new home and things go crazy when we introduce him to his new playmate, a sheep called Albert.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: Our vet Johan has to run for his life when a darted lion wakes up unexpectedly. The struggle continues to get our baby elephant Themba to drink milk. And the game capture team is tackling the world’s deadliest animal, the hippo.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: It’s a race against time to bring in the world’s biggest animal – the elephant. It’s gone down in a bad position and has stopped breathing. There’s a baby boom out on the reserve – we are lucky enough to watch the birth of a giraffe.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: It’s a race against time to bring in the world’s biggest animal – the elephant. It’s gone down in a bad position and has stopped breathing. There’s a baby boom out on the reserve – we are lucky enough to watch the birth of a giraffe.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Davis Life Pod"
programme.desc: Today we will try an invention that can save lives at sea.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Syrian Torpedo"
programme.desc: Today we will see what happens when you combine traditional blacksmithing, gunpowder and water.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "The Bourne Submarine"
programme.desc: Today we will see if it is possible to make an old-school wooden submarine under water and above all back on the surface.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Water Powered Saw"
programme.desc: A gigantic table saw sounds good, especially if it;s only powered by water.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Wind Wagon"
programme.desc: This could have changed history in the Middle Ages. We will make wind powered war chariot.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Ned Kelly"
programme.desc: See how a 19th Century bulletproof suit of armor holds up to 21st Century firepower.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Zhang Heng's Seismometer"
programme.desc: Witness the recreation of a 2,000-year-old earthquake alarm that, if effective, could have saved the lives of thousands.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Battering Ram"
programme.desc: The invention of the battering ram was a breakthrough thousands of years ago, but does it still pack a punch?

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Chinese War Kite"
programme.desc: Join Matt and Jeremy as they combine 13th century Chinese fire arrow technology with a 17th century Japanise kite design to see if they can command the battlefield with this amazing device.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Pedestrian Protectoc"
programme.desc: Can we protect both pedestrians and drivers? Watch this episode to find out.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Aerosan"
programme.desc: Did the soviets invent an invincible snowmobile? Let's see.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "52 Blocks - Tear Coleman"
programme.desc: Tear hails from New York City and is a 52 blocks master, a defensive fighting style invented by African Americans in prisons. Instead of hitting, you block.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Land Gaining Ground"
programme.desc: Earthrise looks at methods of land restoration and conservation as human causes and climate change wreak havoc.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Survival"
programme.desc: As the US no longer stands to be a global climate leader, China takes the mantle.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Antarctica On The Edge"
programme.desc: Earthrise sets off on a month-long journey around Antarctica to study the effects of climate change on the continent.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Coping With Extremes"
programme.desc: Earthrise assesses the depth of the crisis facing the world’s grasslands today, and explores some of the solutions that are being used to preserve them.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "En Route Control"
programme.desc: Most air traffic control does NOT take place in a tower but rather in an area control center like this.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Aircraft Auctions"
programme.desc: Getting a bargain while purchasing aircraft in a unique and fast-paced way.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Mikey McBryan"
programme.desc: Anthony chats with the star of TV’s ‘Ice Pilots’.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Day in the Life of an Airline Pilot"
programme.sub-title: Day in the Life of an Airline Pilot
programme.desc: Raeleen shows us what a typical day is like for her as an airline first officer.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programme.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programme.sub-title: Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies
programme.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programme.sub-title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
programme.desc: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish"
programme.sub-title: Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish
programme.desc: To discover how his favourite meal—fish supper followed by rice pudding—is made, Lord Prescott visits the Ambrosia factory in Devon to explore the production of classic British desserts. Returning north to Grimsby, he heads to the Young's factory to learn about their famous fish pie.

programme.title: Trains That Changed The World S1 - "World On The Move"
programme.desc: Travelling between cities around the world becomes easier, and the solution in the United Kingdom became steam that ran under the city - the London Underground.

programme.title: Trains That Changed The World S1 - "Supertrains"
programme.desc: The modern supertrains of Mainland China.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
programme.desc: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
programme.desc: Find out how Fiat didn't just make cars: they made trains, they made planes, and like modern-day kingmakers, they made and broke governments too.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "The People's Car"
programme.desc: While America had Ford or Chrysler or Buick, Hitler also wanted a car that would transform his nation: the 'people's car'- a Volkswagen.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
programme.desc: The incredible story of the arms race to create America's nuclear arms factories.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programme.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, the USAF learned most pilot losses happened in their first 10 missions, leading to intense training that saves lives.

programme.title: Married To The Mob
programme.desc: When her mobster husband is iced by a ruthless kingpin, Angela finds a job in a beauty salon.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A group of young hackers become embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystem.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of a nun's (Susan Sarandon) relationship with a condemned man (Sean Penn).

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: Author Truman Capote embarks upon a journey to write what will become the book of a lifetime.

programme.title: Witness For The Prosecution
programme.desc: Marlene Dietrich stars in an exceptional courtroom drama about a man on trial for a wealthy widow's murder.

programme.title: 12 Angry Men (1957)
programme.desc: A lone juror must convince eleven others that a teen accused of murder is innocent.

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen roles, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best in this piercing drama.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In this classic, two women embark on an unintentional crime spree across the American west.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In this classic, two women embark on an unintentional crime spree across the American west.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dollars
programme.desc: The Man With No Name devises a plan to destroy the criminals who are terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: The Man With No Name goes up against a lethal gunman as they both pursue a killer and his gang.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Ugly
programme.desc: The Man With No Name is back and in lethal pursuit of $200,000 in Confederate money.

programme.title: Midnight Cowboy
programme.desc: A con man and a naïve hustler from Texas try to survive on the unforgiving streets of New York.

programme.title: Hoosiers
programme.desc: A downtrodden basketball coach’s unwavering passion for the game inspires a reluctant team.

programme.title: Rain Man
programme.desc: A man takes his autistic savant brother on an unforgettable cross-country road trip.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Shirley MacLaine are delightful in this tale of love and ambition.

programme.title: Irma La Douce
programme.desc: Billy Wilder's bawdy, charming and romantic farce about a French policeman who falls in love with a prostitute

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Body Of Evidence
programme.desc: After a night of unbridled passion, Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) finds herself on trial for murder. Now it's up to her attorney (Willem Dafoe) to prove her innocence...but the road to the truth may prove to have as many curves as his seductive client!

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Into The Blue 2: The Reef
programme.desc: Sebastion and Dani, owners of a small diving company in Hawaii, are excited when hired by jet-setters offering big money for help in finding a sunken treasure. But the young pair soon find that the job will test their diving – and survival - skills!

programme.title: Rob Roy
programme.desc: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange give extraordinary performances as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor and the loyal woman who gave him the courage to fight! Tim Roth, in an Oscar®-nominated performance, also stars.

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: The Man In The Iron Mask
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a phenomenal cast in this thrilling tale of majesty and Musketeers. When the excesses of France's arrogant King Louis XIV begin to threaten his subjects' very lives, the legendary Musketeers reunite to save their country!

programme.title: Angel Unchained
programme.desc: Needing a change, Angel quits his biker gang and joins a hippie commune in the desert. But trouble arises from a band of local cowboys who try to force them off their land; so Angel calls his biker pals. And when they roll in, all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
programme.desc: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: Good Guys Wear Black
programme.desc: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

programme.title: Good Guys Wear Black
programme.desc: Action superstar Chuck Norris stars as John T. Booker, the former leader of an elite commando unit who must uncover the reason why his former squad members are being systematically murdered one by one. Anne Archer and James Franciscus co-star.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: Code Of Silence
programme.desc: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Hero And The Terror
programme.desc: A murderer (Jack O'Halloran) escapes from an institution, determined to destroy the cop who sent him away, Chuck Norris. Norris must anticipate "The Terror's" next move, knowing deep down he will have to face this homicidal beast alone.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Julie (Claire Danes), Pete (Giovanni Ribisi) and Linc (Omar Epps) are three problem teens headed to jail...until Captain Greer (Dennis Farina) offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene. It’s a case that the cops can’t crack, but when Greer sends in his new task force – The Mod Squad – they quickly uncover a crime ring involving drugs, hookers...and dirty cops!

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threatens to kill hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Two undercover officers spiral out of control, becoming lovers and addicts as they infiltrate a local drug scene to bring down a supplier.

programme.title: Gandhi My Father

programme.title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3

However, Langda plots against Omkara, manipulating him into believing his wife has been unfaithful. The film explores themes of jealousy, betrayal, and revenge, and features powerful performances and intense action sequences.

programme.desc: Back in college, Natasha (Karisma Kapoor) was obsessed with Vicky (Akshay Kumar), who has become a successful rock star. Nothing ever happened between them, however. At the time, Vicky was in love with Anjali (Amisha Patel), who one fateful night suffered a great loss because of him. Now Natasha is the owner of a music label and has the power to make Vicky a global phenomenon. While Vicky, who is still with Anjali, wants to keep things professional, Natasha isn't about to take no for an answer.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: There are heroes--there are superheroes--and then there's Hancock. With great power comes great responsibility--everyone knows that--everyone, that is, but Hancock. Edgy, conflicted, sarcastic, and misunderstood, Hancock's well-intentioned heroics might get the job done and save countless lives, but always seem to leave jaw-dropping damage in their wake. The public has finally had enough--as grateful as they are to have their local hero, the good citizens of Los Angeles are wondering what they ever did to deserve this guy. Hancock isn't the kind of man who cares what other people think--until the day that he saves the life of PR executive Ray Embrey, and the sardonic superhero begins to realize that he may have a vulnerable side after all. Facing that will be Hancock's greatest challenge yet--and a task that may prove impossible as Ray's wife, Mary, insists that he's a lost cause.

programme.desc: When unproduced Broadway playwright Skip Donahue (Gene Wilder) and his best friend, out-of-work actor Harry Monroe (Richard Pryor), are both fired from their dead-end jobs, they abandon Broadway and set out in their battered van to find fame and fortune in Hollywood. But the van breaks down on the way, and they're forced to take jobs as dancing woodpeckers in a bank promotion. Their troubles are just beginning, as their feathered costumes are swiped by a pair of hoods who use them in a holdup, and Skip and Harry are soon carted off to prison. There they try to keep their sanity and their lives as they deal with a sadistic warden, a hulking mass-murderer and the inter-prison rodeo, which may provide them with the opportunity to walk away -- but at a considerable sacrifice.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.
